Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building sizes, ages, classrooms, specialty spaces, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessment across major systems with Facilities Condition Index scores and detailed campus assessments (Ch. 2.9-2.13, Appendices).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed long-term enrollment projections with methodology, capacity utilization by site and classroom, and explicit strategies for addressing overcrowding including expansions, school reopenings, and reconfigurations (Ch. 2.6-2.10).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications supporting 21st century learning, specialty classrooms (STEM, CTE, special education), and integration of instructional priorities into facility projects (Ch. 2.11-2.12, site plans).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis on outdoor spaces including playground and playfield sizes, shade structures, and some greening strategies; mentions outdoor learning and wellness connections but lacks fully districtwide greening strategy (Site plans and playground data across campuses).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Minimal mention of climate risks or resilience; no detailed climate risk assessment or integrated climate mitigation strategies evident in the plan or appendices.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: References energy efficiency strategies including solar photovoltaics, energy conservation measures, and Proposition 39 funding; discusses some energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive districtwide energy resilience and electrification plan (Ch. 2.11, Funding Studies).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects, prioritization framework aligned with district goals, multiple funding sources including bonds, state grants, developer fees, and detailed financial planning including contingencies and long-term sustainability (Ch. 3.1-3.4, Funding Studies).
